speaker: Doctor
text: Given the lack of response to antibiotics, normal infectious workup, and the worsening of symptoms with lower humidity, this pattern is highly suggestive of Eosinophilic Pneumonia. Have you noticed any hives, eczema, or other allergic reactions in the past, and do you take any medications like beta-blockers, ACE inhibitors, or NSAIDs?
